title: MZ Fresh install on visustella item core and some parts doesn't show up

posts.author: EraNotech
posts.body:
I am new to rpg maker so I decided to just stick to visustella plugins (8 wave) and installed them to find out that item core doesn't work as pictures show. One, character stat comparison don't show up. Two, I don't know how to enable core to draw data from item to display stats and effects. This, i tried but only number show up
I tried to add what stat the armor add which is health but only number showed up. Stats below are added through plugin setting but thats not a way to do it since there are a lot of stats
I combed through it's wiki for solution but plugin menu dont have a way to deal with first problem? I dont have any other plugin that mess with item menu and the like. And I am incredibly confused because I haven't done any meaningful changes to the plugin yet
